indicator.name: AI readers (weekly) - AI requests to the United States edition (/us/ paths)
indicator.cadence: weekly (re-aggregated daily from daily data; weeks are 7-day blocks from 2026-08-23, Sunday to Saturday, JST)
indicator.data_layer_doc: docs/指標定義_AI読者アクセス.md
indicator.path_scope_note: Only requests whose path starts with /us/ (this edition's pages and API files). Shared root files (/, /llms.txt, /index.json, /api/world.json) are not attributed to any edition. Same definition, same UA table and same self-exclusion rule as the Japan edition; only the path filter differs.
indicator.published_series: Headline = requests Cloudflare verified as known bots (verifiedBotCategory). Unverified counts listed separately; the self-declared total is a reference upper bound only.
indicator.counted: HTTP requests from AI-declared user agents to ai-lifeline.org under this path prefix (Cloudflare edge measurement; our own traffic excluded by UA)
indicator.not_means_1: Not proof that an AI read the page. UA strings are self-declared and can be spoofed; verification is Cloudflare judgement, not ours. Unverified does not mean spoofed.
indicator.not_means_2: Not readers, people or sessions: one request = one file.
indicator.privacy: No IP addresses are collected or stored; raw UA strings are not published, only AI-name classes.
indicator.self_exclusion: Our own traffic is identified by UA and excluded; the excluded counts are published (self_excluded).
indicator.sampling_note: Counts are Cloudflare sample counts (as in the Japan edition); no sampling correction is applied.
indicator.provisional_note: Weeks that have not ended are provisional. Series started with the edition launch, so early weeks are partial.

source.name: Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API (httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups, edge measurement)
source.raw_note: Daily detail is archived every day from the API (8-day retention) into data/cfaccess/raw/
